01 / Overview

Unifying
Healthcare
At Scale.

Traditional clinic management is fragmented — appointments in one tool, records in a cabinet, prescriptions on paper. This creates systemic bottlenecks that cost clinics revenue and patients their health.

Prescripto is a full-stack healthcare ecosystem built on the MERN stack with WebRTC integration. A single authenticated session gives doctors complete patient history, live scheduling, digital prescriptions, and an integrated video consultation room.

02 / The Challenge

Fragmented
Care Is
Broken Care.

Doctors wasted hours chasing patient records across disconnected systems. No-show rates were high because patients lacked instant rebooking. Video consultations required third-party tools with no calendar integration — leading to missed slots and billing gaps.

The core engineering challenge: build a system where booking, records, video, and billing share a single data layer — with zero state divergence across three separate user portals.

{/* ══════════════════════════════════════ SOLUTION — split reversed (img left, text right) ══════════════════════════════════════ */}
03 / The Solution

One Platform.
Three Portals.
Zero Friction.

A single JWT issuer with role-based claims powers three separate React SPAs — Patient, Doctor, and Admin — each with guarded routes and a shared MongoDB data layer.

A custom atomic slot-reservation algorithm running server-side eliminated booking conflicts entirely. WebRTC consultation rooms open only during confirmed time slots — built with self-hosted Socket.io signalling on Railway for sub-800ms connection times.
